summary: The SiteDetail class in the HSPnet.DataLayer namespace is designed to handle site details, including operations like adding, updating, deleting, and copying site details to the database through stored procedures. It also includes methods for retrieving SiteDetail objects based on site ID or a specific ID, utilizing alternative database connections if necessary.
purpose: To manage site details by performing CRUD operations and retrieving information related to specific sites through stored procedures in a database.

workflows.name: CRUD Operations
steps: Add: Uses SiteDetailsAdd procedure to insert new site details based on provided fields if the input is valid.
Update: Uses SiteDetailsUpdate procedure to modify existing site details.
Delete: Uses SiteDetailsDelete procedure to remove site details by ID.
Copy: Uses SiteDetailsCopy procedure to create duplicates of the site details by ID.

workflows.name: Data Retrieval
steps: GetBySiteID: Retrieves a list of SiteDetail objects by SiteID using SiteDetailsSearch stored procedure.
GetByID: Retrieves site details by ID using SiteDetailsSearchID stored procedure.

validations: Response must not be blank for a valid SiteDetail entry.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields: Determines whether to use DescriptionAlt or Description for display.
HeaderChanged: Set to true if HeadingID has changed since the last entry added to the list.
system_behavior: Executes stored procedures to perform database operations.
Formats and assigns Description based on language settings.
Handles incremental numbering and resetting of header levels when HeadingID changes.
